pkgmetadata.longdescription:
The core Perl library shared by all pxvirt/Proxmox VE Perl components. Provides the following key modules:
PVE::Tools — misc utilities (run_command, lock_file, …) PVE::JSONSchema — schema validation and API parameter handling PVE::INotify — inotify-based config file monitoring PVE::SectionConfig — INI-style sectioned config file parser PVE::RESTHandler — REST API handler base class PVE::RESTEnvironment — per-request context for REST handlers PVE::CLIHandler — CLI command dispatch PVE::Network — network interface configuration parsing PVE::ProcFSTools — /proc parsing helpers PVE::CGroup — cgroup v2 helpers PVE::Daemon — daemonisation helpers PVE::Ticket — API ticket (cookie) generation and validation PVE::CalendarEvent — calendar event / cron-like scheduling PVE::OTP — TOTP implementation PVE::Certificate — TLS certificate helpers PVE::LDAP — LDAP authentication PVE::Systemd — systemd unit management via D-Bus PVE::Job::Registry — scheduled job registry
All Perl dependencies are confirmed present in the Gentoo tree (audited 2025-07-03). No XS or C compilation required.
